evidence.clarity: All file:// opens succeed at the required widths with no page or console errors; A probe reports zero overflow at 320, 390, 768 and 1440.
evidence.fit: The one-file page is self-contained and describes the sample state; the demo and carrier destinations match the brief URLs.
evidence.distinctiveness: The sample is implemented as a door-by-time grid, native range clock and labeled door buttons linked to an SVG dock face.
evidence.proof: At each width I operated all six doors and every currently bookable slot; a selected slot opens a form and returns a local reference; Reset restores initial bookings and time.
evidence.craft: A is a large single HTML document with inline SVG/CSS/JS; landmarks and input labels exist, but the probe flags one serious color-contrast node at 1440.
evidence.mobile: At 390 doors collapse into a single selected-door list, 13px is the probe minimum and there is no horizontal overflow; keyboard focus is visible.
evidence.honesty: The action states “nothing is sent” and “sample day,” and the page labels the pilot status and lack of measured outcomes.
evidence.interaction: Empty carrier focuses its input and shows a specific error; a 100-character carrier is capped at 40; zero carrier and negative reference are accepted; reset works. Escape closes the booking sheet but not the phone menu.
evidence.copy: The event handlers update an aria-live status and move focus to the booking/done panel; `innerHTML` is used for static structure while carrier values are set with textContent.
evidence.first_screen: At 1440 the CTA and board are together; at 390 the promise and simulator are visible, but booking actions sit lower on the page.

problems: The phone menu stays open on Escape even though the booking sheet itself supports Escape.
Inline SVG, styling and script in one HTML file make the large implementation harder to review and maintain.
Axe finds a serious color-contrast issue at 1440; identify and correct the offending text color before release.

evidence.clarity: B’s HTML, styles and app script load from disk without console/page errors; probe finds no page overflow at 390, though the inner board is horizontally scrollable.
evidence.fit: The local-only demo needs no backend and its links use the two brief-supplied URLs; no remote asset request is required.
evidence.distinctiveness: CSS and app.js are separated; generated schedule controls have door/time labels and the booking drawer is a form with visible labels.
evidence.proof: All 16 open windows respond and open the drawer. Empty PO gets `aria-invalid` and a requirement placeholder; valid booking updates the sample board and “another” returns to it.
evidence.craft: Probe reports `scrollable-region-focusable` at 390, 11px smallest text, 44 under-12px elements and 0 contrast violations; small booked-cell metadata is truncated.
evidence.mobile: The outer page has no horizontal overflow but the board itself must pan sideways at 390; at 320 as well, the schedule is an independently scrolling region.
evidence.honesty: The script says “sample board” and “nothing leaves the page”; the pilot statement matches the brief’s two unnamed warehouses.
evidence.interaction: At 390 keyboard focus reaches the board and open cells; Enter opens the form, but Escape does not close it. PO 0 and -1 are accepted, 300-character PO is unbounded, and pallet 0/-1 is rejected by native constraints.
evidence.copy: `app.js` isolates generated sample data and handlers, and CSS variables define the palette and schedule widths; it has no server error path because no backend is used.
evidence.first_screen: 1440 shows promise, CTA and booking board; 390 keeps the CTA but the visible schedule exposes only early times and a sideways scroll region.

problems: The mobile board requires sideways panning to reach later booking windows, and its repeated 11px details are below the unreadable-mobile threshold.
Escape does not dismiss the booking drawer after an open slot is selected; the user must find and activate Close.
The PO/BOL field accepts 0, -1 and very long text; only pallet count has native 1–30 bounds.

hard_fail_flags.evidence: At 390 the core booking board is a horizontally scrollable 22-column schedule; only early times fit in the visible strip, later booking buttons require sideways scrolling, and the probe finds 44 text elements below 12px (11px minimum) in the repeated slot details.
hard_fail_flags.steps: Open B/index.html at 390×844 and inspect the board. The initial view shows 06:00–08:00 while the schedule continues to 17:00; scroll `.board-scroll` horizontally to expose later times and booking buttons. The probe reports 44 elements under 12px.

reason: A has a maintainability cost because it is a single large file, and its menu misses Escape, but its board reflows and its state/reset path works. B separates files and labels its sample well; the 390 board still requires sideways scrolling and has 11px repeated details, which makes A the safer implementation to ship.
